name: Tower of Fangs: Summoned to Another World, I Was Locked in a Tower with 299 Strikers, Only the Last Egoist Goes Home
summary: He passed the ball in the final. The goal swallowed him whole. Now Hino Kakeru is trapped in an isekai tower with 299 strikers, and only the last egoist goes home. Devour rivals' Fangs, fuse super moves, unleash duo combos and climb 24 floors of anime football action with 4 endings and local 2P.
